settings.title: What's included
settings.content: A flat-band coordinates ring and an adjustable matching cuff bracelet, each carrying the full coordinate pair on one engraved line.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter one verified coordinate pair or customize the ring and cuff separately. 2. Review both layouts and confirm the measured ring size. 3. Check the two submitted engravings in the cart before checkout.

settings.atc_label: Add to cart — free engraving on every piece
